name: Bereshit Rabbah — Hebrew Wikisource, chapters 1–100
attribution: Bereshit Rabbah, chapters 1–100, Hebrew Wikisource contributors. Each source passage, pinned revision, and contributor history, including replacement source pages, is listed in source-manifest.json. CC BY-SA 4.0. Bereshit Rabbah 68:14: Lviv 1874 edition via Sefaria; see lviv-68-source-evidence.json.
changes: Removed navigation, editing controls, style, scripts, an external-links section, a separate Rashi section and dynamically transcluded commentary; joined source paragraphs as one passage per page and escaped markup. Source passage numbering is retained; redirect aliases and one unlisted empty page were excluded and a source omission notice retained. The mismatched source pages 51:1 and 57:1 were withheld; Seven empty pages in chapters 61–62 and eleven empty pages in chapters 66–68 remain empty. A duplicate explicitly marked chapter 52:1 was removed from the end of 51:11; it remains at 52:1. No OCR or new translation was performed by Amudi. The current source text and revision summaries were checked for OCR notices, but all prior revision text was not audited. Adaptations remain under CC BY-SA 4.0. Chapters 70:3, 70:5 and 70:10 use same-text source pages mislabelled as chapter 71; the erroneous source text at 71:1, 71:3, 71:5 and 71:10 is withheld. Empty pages remain empty. For chapters 73–80, navigation and a separately transcluded Matnot Kehunah commentary section were removed; fourteen empty source pages remain empty. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 81–88, navigation was removed and two empty source pages remain empty. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 89–96, navigation and page edit controls were removed; source explanatory glosses were retained as part of the credited source edition. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 97–100, navigation and page edit controls were removed. At chapter 99 the source combines two passages and subsequent numbering differs from the comparison edition. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. Passage 68:14 restored from Sefaria’s pinned export of Midrash Rabbah - Bereshit (Lviv, 1874), marked Public Domain; the Hebrew Wikisource source page for that position is empty.

translations.name: Sefaria Midrash Rabbah 2022 (aligned passages)
translations.attribution: The Sefaria Midrash Rabbah, 2022; translator Joshua Schreier; managing editor Jason Rappoport; editors Michael Siev and Yaacov Francus; copy editors Deborah Meghnagi Bailey and Ilana Sobel; Sefaria. CC BY 3.0.
translations.changes: Amudi selected source English passages by chapter and uniquely matched Hebrew passage; where numbering differs, the matching source paragraph is used. One hundred fifty-three passages received additional manual topic comparison. Source English 99:6 and 99:7 are joined at Wikisource 99:6; source English paragraphs 16:4 and 16:5 are joined at Wikisource 16:4 because the Hebrew source combines them. English 7:5, 51:1, 57:1, 61:1–2 and 62:1–4, 66:1–2, 66:6–7, 67:4, 67:10–13 68:11, and missing Hebrew slots in chapters 70–74 and 84:20, 22 are displayed by their own source references while the corresponding Wikisource Hebrew slots are empty; they are not claimed aligned to missing Hebrew. English 53:13, 63:8, 68:12, 69:3 and selected 93 passages include visible edition-variant notices describing material differences. Other unmatched positions are blank. No OCR or new translation; source English wording is retained. English 38:14 is shown by its own source reference with a notice that the Hebrew is unavailable.
translations.coverageStatus: 1034 of 1036 local passage slots contain source English. Chapter 7:5 is English-only because the Hebrew source page is empty; source 16:5 is combined with 16:4. This edition is partial. English 38:14 is shown by source reference only; the Hebrew source page is empty. English 51:1 is displayed by source reference only; the Wikisource Hebrew was withheld because its subject belongs elsewhere. English 53:13 includes a notice that the editions disagree on Ishmael’s age. English 57:1 is source-reference-only because the Hebrew page is mislabeled. English 61:1–2 and 62:1–4 are source-reference-only because the Hebrew pages are empty; the English source has four passages in chapter 62 while the empty Wikisource slots number five. Hebrew 99:6 combines source English 99:6 and 99:7; later source passage numbers in chapter 99 shift by one. English at the two empty Hebrew slots in chapter 84 is shown by source reference only, where available. English at the fourteen empty Hebrew slots in chapters 73–74 is shown by source reference only, where available. English at empty or withheld Hebrew slots in chapters 70–72 is shown by source reference only, where available. English at empty Hebrew slots in chapters 66–68 is shown by source reference only, where available. English 63:8 includes a notice that the editions disagree on the day a decree was sent.
